body.statement: For the exact worked instance \(W_3^{(2)}\), supply a reduced rational identifying formula and graph-ideal certificate for every \(q\in\theta_{W_3^{(2)}}\); an exhaustive half-trek witness, instrumental-cutset, and auxiliary-cutset search transcript proving \(\operatorname{HTCcert}(W_3^{(2)})=\operatorname{ICcert}(W_3^{(2)})=\operatorname{ACcert}(W_3^{(2)})=0\); and, for every \(S\in\operatorname{Reach}_4(W_3^{(2)})\) with \(\zeta_3\notin S\), the exact monomial-basis matrix of \(m_{\zeta,S}:C_4(S)\to(A_4(S)+\zeta_3C_4(S))/A_4(S)\), its rank, and a displayed nonzero \(\dim C_4(S)\)-square minor. Then prove for every \(\ell\ge3\) that \(W_{\ell}^{(2)}\) is generically birational onto its covariance image and that \[\operatorname{HTCcert}(W_{\ell}^{(2)})=\operatorname{ICcert}(W_{\ell}^{(2)})=\operatorname{ACcert}(W_{\ell}^{(2)})=0.\] Supply rational identifying formulas or exact graph-ideal certificates for all coordinates and complete failure transcripts for all three criteria. Consequently the family lies in \(\mathcal G_{2}^{\mathrm{rat}}(2\ell)\) and strictly separates rational identification at directed indegree two from the bounded half-trek, instrumental-cutset, and auxiliary-cutset subclasses, in particular from auxiliary cutsets.
body.justification: A lower-bound family must first be shown to inhabit the unclassified portion of the rationally identifiable indegree-two class.
body.gap: Hollering, Misra, and Sturma's Proposition 7.4 gives the auxiliary-cutset bound \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^4+2s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^3+s_{\mathrm{HMS}}^2\), hence \(36\) at \(s_{\mathrm{HMS}}=2\), but does not show that auxiliary cutsets exhaust rational identification at this indegree.
body.consumer: The sharp-frontier lower bound receives an explicit legal family that cannot inherit a bounded certificate from any of the three published subclass guarantees.
